Q. $\alpha ^2$ ও $\beta ^2$ মূলবিশিষ্ট সমীকরণ-
explanation:
$\alpha^2$ ও $\beta^2$ মূলবিশিষ্ট সমীকরণ,

$বা, x^2-\left(\alpha^2+\beta^2\right) x+\alpha^2 \beta^2=0$

$বা, x^2-\left\{(\alpha+\beta)^2-2 \alpha \beta\right\} x+(\alpha \beta)^2=0$

$বা x^2-\left(\frac{25}{9}-\frac{2}{3}\right) x+\frac{1}{9}=0$

$ বা x^2-\frac{19}{9} x+\frac{1}{9}=0$

$ \therefore 9 x^2-19 x+1=0 .$
